column3:
I find it difficult to describe my love for this game, it reminds me of a simpler time back in high school playing rocket league. The excitement and joy I feel when I make a play and block a shot or snipe a goal is immense. This game is a gem, make no mistake, a diamond that needs some polishing to reach its true potential. I will touch on these 'polishes later'.

My journey with this game was sudden and unexpected, my friend out of nowhere demanded I try the game and I relented. As a person who prefers and enjoys supporting and defending the team, naturally I was meant to be a goalie main (In Omega Strikes there are two roles, goalie and forward). We played some normal matches (Normal is the standard game mode in which it mirrors the competitive mode but a tad more casual), shots shot, misplays galore, screams made and many LETS GOOOO were had. We were hooked. I was hooked.

But pure elation turned to confusion as we exited the matches and tried to navigate the main menu. And here is my main criticism: The UI is difficult to traverse, obtuse at times and a hot buggy mess at worst. I am unsure if it is an issue on my end or the game but I still, to this day, have no idea to check my account progression outside of the match report screen and the Striker Affinity (the leveling system for each character where you earn profile borders, emotes, style points and other goodies) displays incorrect information (such as different values for progressive than post match screen) and flat out refusing to let me redeem my due rewards. However, despite only playing this game for less then a week, have faith that these will be fixed!

Overall Omega Strikers is a trip, a game full of love and passion. One that I am enjoying immensely, I cant wait to see if me and lads and break into Plat this season. I wish the beast for this game and the devs, something I cant say for all games. God bless and god speed fellow gamers.

column3:
Omega Strikers is a fantastic game that is unfortunately heading towards a quick death due to the developers' poor handling of it. The beta last year raised a number of issues regarding lacking QoL features, no penalty for leavers, no real tutorial or practice mode, and poor team communication. The developers proceeded to address absolutely none of these things for the full release, instead reworking the basic gameplay mechanics. While I think the gameplay was improved as a result, completely failing to address those issues just left new players with the same frustrations people had in beta, and it took them far too long after release to actually start addressing things.

Meanwhile they threw their entire advertising budget into paying streamers to play the game, which has evidently not worked as a marketing strategy for keeping players around when combined with the above. The ranking-based matchmaking has also been flat out broken with high rank players getting matched against low-rank ones and slaughtering them. Their solution to this was to stop high rank players from teaming up, which just meant those players made new accounts and slaughtered people at low ranks instead, making the problem even worse.On top of that they introduced new bugs over time like one where matches would randomly be played at 300 ping instead of the usual low ping. This has been going on for three weeks and has yet to be fixed. (Edit: after three months they finally fixed this bug.) When they finally did introduce a surrender function and AFK detection, I have not actually had either work at all, with AFK players not being detected, surrender only being available when winning instead of losing, and full penalties incurred for losing 2v3 matches. The massive technical shortcomings on display here have kneecapped a game that should've had a bright future.

Unfortunately at this point the OCE region is basically dead. After two failed launches I don't see them coming back from this. It's an incredible shame to see the game die when I enjoyed it so much while it was actually playable, but the devs already had everything they needed to know from beta to not have the full release launch in the state it did.

column3:
Very unfortunate changes on release date.

Omega Strikers beta was incredible:
- quick 5-10 min matches
- you would preban characters before searching for matches
- you would preselect your "trainings" which would change how your character is played.

Now everything is done during the match.  When I saw how Omega Strikers did it previously i was very happy, and thought "This is a clever way to ban, but not waste everybody's time".

Devs justify new system with limited build variety being played when they specifically forced 2/3 of your build on every character.  Really should've tried removing the restriction and see how the player base worked with the new trainings added.

Instead trainings are now RNG based. After each set you have to pray that nobody picks what you wanted, or be left with a upgrade that doesn't work as well.  A very win-more loop combined with longer game times can feel extremely bad.
Great for a more "fun" game, but sucks on a competitive level.  They also fumbled the bag since the strongest characters on release were boring X, Atlas and Asher.  And the biggest laugh of it, the newest character on release, Zentaro was laughable at best while having a really unique and fun kit.

Matches are now played in a Tennis like matter. Which means it can go on forever.
Previously, if the 5 minutes were up, and there was a difference of 2 points. Good game. Play another.
Now a set can take 5-10 minutes. Theoretically you could play up to 5. (since first to three wins), that's anywhere for 25-50 minutes.
Previously it also felt like as you leveled up, and hit the core harder. That as the match progressed the pacing would increase, speeding up until eventually someone lost. Now pacing restarts constantly with sets.

Additionally it feels like beta players are being screwed over.
- emotes that were rewarded for playing mobile beta previously, are now being given as daily login rewards
- normal currency you could spend on emotes is now useless, since there is a NEW blue currency, for cosmetics.

Even if I would buy all characters i would have 100,000+ credits saved up from beta which mean nothing.
